title: Astrid and the Smile
author: Ivo Delacroix
blurb: Wendell Amberdale, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
